text:
maria: Heads-up — CloudGate reported a marketplace perf SEV, high request latency for their listing. Need to confirm escalation path and warroom setup. @leo @jordan can you confirm?

sam: Ack. Do they want the shared partner channel or a private warroom this time? Last time there was confusion.

leo: We agreed previously to use the shared channel for info, but spawn a dedicated warroom for SEVs: convention `#warroom-<partner>-sev-<short>`. Shared `#partners-cloudgate` stays as the landing pad.

anika: +1 on convention. `#warroom-cloudgate-sev-202604` (or short date) works. Makes automation and retention rules easier. :white_check_mark:

partner-bot: [auto] warroom-template available: `#warroom-cloudgate-sev` — use `/create-warroom warroom-cloudgate-sev` to instantiate, it will auto-invite `@partner-liaison` and `@oncall-eng-sre`.

jordan: Oncall plan: my team triages first 15m, if no resolution escalate to infra + runtime team. Need the marketplace request ids and example payloads to reproduce. Add runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/marketplace-sev

maria: Quick checklist to run in the warroom: 1) confirm channel + invite list 2) collect sample request IDs & logs 3) check routing & model variant (rollback vs mitigation) 4) apply temporary routing policy if needed 5) schedule postmortem + owner. Who owns liaison comms to CloudGate?

leo: I'll own liaison comms and CSM loop. I'll DM Maria the contact and invite them to the warroom. Also ask CloudGate for `request_id` and a couple of full headers (timestamp, region, model).

anika: Ops note — we should enable a fallback routing rule to a smaller model/region while we investigate. Example policy snippet to apply ASAP: ```json
{
  "policy_name": "marketplace-fallback-cloudgate",
  "match": {"route.tag": "cloudgate-listing"},
  "actions": [{"type": "route","target": "small-model-variant","priority": 10}]
}
```

sam: Got it, I'll push that policy and monitor token/latency metrics. Adding 24h follow-up cadence to the warroom agenda.

maria: Thanks all. I'll drop the postmortem template and a short comms draft in the warroom. Please flag any SLA exposures so legal can review.

partner-bot: [auto] warroom `#warroom-cloudgate-sev` instantiated by leo at 1718743360. Invited: maria, sam, leo, anika, jordan, partner-liaison-cloudgate.

maria: If we resolve, we'll archive the warroom and publish a short tl;dr to #partners-summary. Keep updates short and timestamped.

partner-bot: [auto] warroom archived after resolution (resolution_ts: 1718747200) — root cause: cache warmup race on marketplace-side; mitigation: enabled fallback routing + increased cache TTL. :white_check_mark:
